name: model-manager
description: GitHub Copilot Custom Model Config Manager

scripts.build: npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --targets node20-win-x64 --output CopilotModelManager.exe --compress Brotli && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s='CopilotModelManager.exe',t='CopilotModelManager.tmp';const f=fs.readFileSync(s);const pe=f.readInt32LE(0x3C);f[pe+24+68]=2;fs.writeFileSync(t,f);fs.renameSync(t,s);console.log('PE subsystem -> GUI')"
